name: idle_hero_r1__t6_control

spec._doc: Gesture spec for the processional hero idle at 144 px, round R1 (tools/art-construct/figure_paint.py). Starts from the C1 spec (idle_hero.gesture.json: wide stance t2, collar hand) and adds the R1 part sizes from DESIGN 2 at 144 (bell sleeves with a 27 px mouth, the hime back hair to mid-thigh, the veil), limb radii from the 3D reference layer, and a far-hand pose switch (collar | hip). Units as the C1 spec: h = px above the sole, dx = px from the body centre at the feet (+ = the facing side). Every number is [I] until the learning log (ART-RULES 10, round R1) records it.
spec.name: idle_hero_r1__t6_control

zones._doc: polygons in dx/h (the checker converts). keep_out: nothing of the named kind may be inside. must_be: the named thing must be there.

keep_out.name: between the eyes below the lash

spec._tilt_doc: tilt_deg = angle of the near->far line; + = the far (screen-right) side higher. Weight on the far leg: far hip up (+), shoulders the other way (-).

thumbnails.name: t1_c1hero
thumbnails.idea: the C1 hero gesture (wide stance, glaive 17 deg out, hand at the collar cross) with the R1 masses
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#4, 10/11): with the DESIGN-size bell (27 px mouth) the collar hand drapes the far sleeve across the chest and closes the far arm window (FG-N04, block) and hides the chest window; C1 passed only because its sleeve was a third of the size. Built full size as idle_hero_r1_collar for the A/B record

thumbnails.name: t2_hiphand
thumbnails.idea: far hand on the far hip (the 3D reference's pose, C1's A/B alternative t5): the far sleeve hangs beside the hip and opens a triangle window
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT, HERO (#1, 11/11, gap 316 px2): the hand on the far hip keeps a clean triangle window; the far bell hangs beside the hip, so torso, chest window and collar cross stay clear; the most attitude at 1x

thumbnails.name: t3_haft24
thumbnails.idea: glaive leaning 24 deg with the butt 2 px nearer and the grip 5 px lower (so the fist can reach it: C1 log, GR-P05), the near arm reaching further out: a wider wedge of background
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#5, 9/11): the collar hand's FG-N04 plus the 24 deg glaive's GR-P10

thumbnails.name: t4_push
thumbnails.idea: push the contrapposto a step (FG-N09): shoulders -10, hips +10, head roll 1 more
thumbnails.verdict: dropped (#3, 10/11): +/-10 deg tilts sit outside FG-P09 (hip 4-10 each way was read as +10 vs -10 failing); by eye the extra tilt reads as a sway, not more attitude

thumbnails.name: t5_hip_haft24
thumbnails.idea: t2 and t3 together: hand on the hip plus the steeper glaive
thumbnails.verdict: KEPT (#2, 10/11, gap 347 px2, widest silhouette): the steeper glaive opens the wedge, but the haft passes 3 px from the near sleeve (GR-P10 wants 4-8 or an overlap >= 3); next round: move the butt 2 px out or let the haft overlap the bell

thumbnails.name: t6_control
thumbnails.idea: control: level shoulders and hips, both knees straight (the mannequin); must score last
thumbnails.verdict: control, last (#6, 7/11): level shoulders and hips, locked knees: FG-P08/P09/P10 and FG-N04 fail as they should

_decisions: round R1 (2026-09-29): six thumbnails built with the final R1 part models and scored on 11 silhouette rules; t2_hiphand (#1) and t5_hip_haft24 (#2) kept; the hero is t2. The collar hand DESIGN 1 names fails FG-N04 once the bell sleeves are at DESIGN size (the drape closes the window and covers the chest window); that is listed for Dex in DESIGN 13 and logged in ART-RULES 10 (R1).

log: gesture: joints from targets by IK; weight on the far foot
mannequin: rib cage and pelvis boxes on one spine; limbs as tapered cylinders
r1: dressed at DESIGN sizes (bell sleeves, hime back hair, veil), painted r1 head; one key light from the upper front (the facing side); outline and contact lines as C1
_doc: the spec this sprite was built from (tools/art-construct/figure_paint.py, round R1) and the log
